title: Owner setup
intro: Everything Honest OS needs before the team starts: the main warehouse, territories, people with roles and logins, each rep's base address, then the data from the old system. Work down the list; every step can be repeated.

steps.catalog: Brands and category for old items

warehouse.title: 1. Main warehouse
warehouse.intro: Opening stock is received into this warehouse. Negative stock stays off.
warehouse.codeHint: The opening-stock file uses WH-MAIN; keep it unless you change the file too.
warehouse.name: Name

territories.title: 2. Territories
territories.intro: A territory's coverage (governorate, optionally a city) decides where new customers belong. Start with Mansoura.
territories.mansouraHint: Mansoura is in Dakahlia (EG-DK). Cover the whole governorate with the Mansoura territory so imported customers land there.

people.title: 3. People, roles and logins
people.intro: Add each person, then give them a login with a role: sales manager, reps, finance. Reps also need a base address: leads are searched around it.
people.jobTitleHint: A job title grants nothing; the role chosen with the login does.
people.needsEmail: Add an e-mail on the employee's page first (Admin → Employees).

imports.title: 4. Data from the old system
imports.intro: Convert the workbook with pnpm legacy:convert (files go to private/import), then upload each file on Data import in this order: upload, check the preview, validate, commit.

files.prices: Base price list (DEFAULT). Needs the products.
files.stock: Opening stock in WH-MAIN. Needs the products and the main warehouse. Unknown costs stay unknown.
files.customers: Customers. Pick the governorate for rows without one (Mansoura = Dakahlia). Customers without a phone are marked to complete.
files.openingAr: Opening balances owed to HONEST. Needs the customers.
files.credits: Credit balances. Import only after you have confirmed them.

imports.phoneMissing: {count} customers have no phone yet: reps complete them on their next visit.
imports.catalogHint: Before the products file: add the brands and category the old system's items use ({codes}).
imports.catalogAdd: Add brands STEP, GENERIC and category IMPLANT_PARTS
imports.catalogReady: The brands and category the old items use exist.

base.addressHint: Where the rep starts the day, in Arabic or English. Find on map looks it up with Google.
base.radiusHint: Default 5 km. Leads are searched within this distance of the base point.
base.approximate: Google's match is approximate: check the point on the map.

problems.not_configured: Map search is not configured (no Google server key yet). Type the point, or skip for now.
problems.not_found: Google found no place for this address. Make it more precise, or type the point.
problems.outside_egypt: Google placed this address outside Egypt. Type the point instead.
problems.error: Map search is not available right now. Type the point, or try again later.

login.smtpNote: E-mail invites need SMTP in Supabase (Authentication → SMTP), which is not set up yet. Until then you get a one-time link to send to the person yourself.
login.linkInvite: Login created for {email}. Send this link privately:
login.linkSignIn: One-time sign-in link for {email}. Send it privately:
login.linkWarning: Anyone with this link signs in as this person. Send it only to them (WhatsApp or SMS), never in a group. It works once and expires after the project's e-mail link lifetime (Supabase default: 1 hour). Make a new one any time.
login.partial: The link works, but one step failed. Fix it on Admin → Users or Employees.
